Cultivation Stories

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Linux

Download NowName your own price

Cultivation Stories is a xianxia life sim in pixel art. Before you start, the game builds a world and runs a few centuries of it: villages, sects, families, grudges, wars. Then you make a character and get born into it. Nobody was waiting for you.

I'm making it alone. This is a very early demo (0.1.9) and it's rough. There are bugs, some screens look unfinished, and all the art, music and sound are placeholders for now.

That's really why it's here. I want to know what confused you, what bored you, what you liked, and what you'd want the game to have. Tell me in the Community tab or the comments or come and tell me in the game discord! https://discord.gg/Wvp9nJm3b

What you can do

Walk around villages and the wild, talk to people, fight, trade, forge and brew. You aim at body parts in combat and wounds last. You can sense the people and beasts around you, as far as your realm allows. The demo stops at Qi Condensation, layer 1: the next breakthrough is closed, but you can keep playing or start another character in the same world. English and Spanish.






Controls

WASD to walk, Shift to run, Ctrl to sneak, E to interact, Tab for the diary, C to cultivate, K to open the Cultivation screen, M for the map, Esc to pause. The game autosaves after every action. But I recommend having a manual save.

Requirements

Windows 10/11 64-bit, 4 GB RAM, a GPU with Vulkan 1.2, 1.5 GB of disk space. Linux and macOS builds exist but I haven't tested them properly, so tell me if they work for you.
